name: News, Front Pages
description: Today's newspaper front pages from the Freedom Forum archive, one paper per render, filling the cell's width from the top. Rotates through the papers listed under Settings → Widgets → News, Front Pages, each with its own optional CSS, or shows one pinned paper. The rotation moves on at most once every four minutes, so a send prepared ahead of time and its follow-ups show one paper; that approximates one paper per shown frame, and two sends within four minutes repeat a paper. Pages download in the background as PDFs, drawn 1440 px wide so body text stays readable (Freedom Forum's 700 px JPEG stands in when a PDF can't be had), and the last good page stays up while a paper isn't out yet. No API key needed.

cell_options.name: paper
cell_options.label: Paper
cell_options.help: One paper every time, or the next paper from the list in the widget's settings on each render.

settings.name: papers
settings.label: Papers
settings.help: The papers to rotate through, in order: one per render, moving on at most every four minutes. Switch a paper off to leave it out of the rotation without losing its row; a cell pinned to it still shows it.

fields.name: code
fields.label: Paper code
fields.pattern_hint: letters, digits, _ and - only, like NY_NYT
fields.help: Freedom Forum's code for the paper, as in its front page addresses (frontpages.freedomforum.org/newspapers/ny_nyt-The_New_York_Times is NY_NYT). The paper picker on a cell lists them all.

fields.name: css
fields.label: CSS
fields.help: Styles this paper's page image only. Move up: transform: translateY(-3%) (positive moves down). Zoom: transform: scale(1.2). Wider: width: 110%. Darker: filter: contrast(1.2). Several: separate with ;
